raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: hepdata-validator
  version: "0.3.6"
  python_min: "3.6"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/hepdata_validator-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e57b97f83509c81d579ccbbd4cdd515043ba32aa1d8543bf31a36a19dcf08fbb

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - hepdata-validate=hepdata_validator.cli:validate

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - pytest
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - click
    - jsonschema
    - packaging
    - pyyaml >=5.4.1
    - requests

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - hepdata_validator
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
    script:
      - hepdata-validate --help

about:
  summary: JSON schema and validation code for HEPData submissions
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/hepdata/hepdata-validator

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - GraemeWatt
    - matthewfeickert
